definitions.full: H1963. hek הֵיךְ adverb how ? ( היך , , id. , in Palestinian Aramaic, as Job 21:34 ᵑ7 , Gen 3:9 ; Deut 1:12 ᵑ7 Pa J; Matt 22:12 ᵑ6 : Jerusalem (though usually these words have the force of as ), and in הֵיכְדֵין how, then? Psa 73:11 + ᵑ7 ; compare Bev Dan.p. 29 ) — only twice, in late Hebrew, 1Chr 13:12 (|| 2Sam 6:9 אֵיךְ ), Dan 10:17 .
